name: adapt_removed_dependency_cpp_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: a header the agent's first solution depends on is DELETED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must stop depending on it
prompts: greeting_data.hpp declares namespace app with a constexpr const char* GREETING. Create a header-only message.hpp that #includes "greeting_data.hpp" and <string>, declaring an inline std::string app::message() returning GREETING.
greeting_data.hpp has just been removed from the project. Update message.hpp so it still compiles with NO reference to greeting_data.hpp, and message() returns exactly "hola".

assert proc.returncode == 0, f'exit {proc.returncode}, stderr={proc.stderr[-300:]}'
